pkgmetadata.longdescription: A GTK4/libadwaita application store for Gentoo's Portage package manager: search, install, and manage packages with a graphical job queue, USE-flag/keyword/license conflict resolution, security-advisory and orphaned-package checks, and an optional Flatpak lane for apps outside the tree.

use.flag: Enable the in-app "Learn More" web view via net-libs/webkit-gtk (large dependency; falls back to opening links in the system browser when off)
